cases.text:
Yes, absolutely! You can use a Trailforge gift card to pay for your order. According to our policy (kb/15-gift-cards.md), gift cards can be used **online or in-store**, so just enter your gift card details at checkout.

If your order total exceeds the gift card balance, you can cover the remaining amount with one of our accepted payment methods (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, or Shop Pay).

Is there anything else I can help you with?
